info.name: Krozenda — User Panel API
info.description: Customer-facing (user panel) API surface for the Krozenda multi-vendor marketplace. Organized by module with positive, negative, unauthorized, IDOR, and edge-case requests. Run "AUTH > Send OTP" then "AUTH > Verify OTP (correct code)" first to populate ACCESS_TOKEN. No secrets are hardcoded — every credential is an environment variable (see Krozenda-Local.postman_environment.json).

request.description: Positive case. In non-production the response includes the OTP (no real SMS gateway wired up yet) — see userAuthController.js.
Negative case: malformed mobile number rejected.
